info.name: SDG Recycling Backend API
info.description:
Shared API test collection for local, shared Azure, and personal sandbox environments.

Import one collection, then switch Postman environments. Run Auth -> Login Admin and Auth -> Login Student first to populate tokens automatically.

Safe Smoke and Admin Read folders are intended for routine checks. Mutation folders create/archive test data and should be used deliberately.

exec: pm.test('badge progress shape', function () { const data = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(data.earned).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(data.locked).to.be.an('array'); });

item.name: 06 - Upload Tests
item.description: Set testFilePath in the active Postman environment before running file upload requests.

item.name: Admin Cannot Use Student Points Endpoint
Claim Recycling QR With Invalid Signature Rejects
08 - Recycling, Rewards & Leaderboard Tests
Get Recycling QR by Id - Admin
Issue Recycling QR - Admin (For Invalidate Test)

exec: pm.test('re-claiming an already-claimed QR is rejected', function () { pm.expect([400, 409]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
pm.test('reviewing an already-reviewed submission is rejected', function () { pm.expect([404, 409]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
pm.test('status 201, 400 (insufficient points), or 429 (redemption cooldown) is acceptable', function () { pm.expect([201, 400, 429]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

if (pm.response.code === 201) { const redemptionId = pm.response.json().data.redemption.id; pm.environment.set('redemptionId', redemptionId); pm.collectionVariables.set('redemptionId', redemptionId); }
pm.test('completes, or is a legitimate conflict/not-found if the redeem step above did not create a fresh reservation', function () { pm.expect([200, 404, 409]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

item.name: Redeem Second Reward For Cancel Test - Student

exec: pm.test('status 201, 400 (insufficient points), or 429 (redemption cooldown) is acceptable', function () { pm.expect([201, 400, 429]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
if (pm.response.code === 201) { const id = pm.response.json().data.redemption.id; pm.environment.set('redemptionIdToCancel', id); pm.collectionVariables.set('redemptionIdToCancel', id); }
pm.test('cancel succeeds, or is a legitimate conflict if funds were insufficient above', function () { pm.expect([200, 404, 409]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

item.name: Redeem Reward With Insufficient Points Fails

exec: pm.test('redeeming above balance is rejected', function () { pm.expect([201, 400]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
if (pm.response.code === 400) { pm.test('error message mentions points', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.message).to.match(/points/i); }); }
pm.test('completing a non-reserved redemption is rejected or already completed', function () { pm.expect([200, 404, 409]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

item.description: Run Recycling -> Issue Recycling QR - Admin before Claim Recycling QR - Student (it captures recyclingQrId/recyclingQrClaimPayload). Run Rewards -> Create Reward - Admin before Update/Deactivate Reward (it captures createdRewardId). Some requests intentionally exercise business-rule rejections (insufficient points, already-reviewed, already-claimed) and accept more than one status code.
